Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast Nature spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Bonus Language

  • Effect: Gain the secret druidic tongue: forbidden to teach to non-druids.
  • Your Intelligence languages may also be chosen from: Elvish, Giant, Gnomish, Primordial, Sylvan.

Nature Lore (Wisdom)

  • Effect: Choose one kind of country you were trained in (forest, hills and mountains, marsh, plains, coast, desert, the frozen north or the Underdark; the GM may allow others). There, all of the following are automatic; elsewhere each needs a Moderate Wisdom check.
  • Identify plants and animals perfectly
  • Determine if water is safe to drink
  • Find basic shelter and enough food for one person automatically
  • Feeding additional people takes 6 hours of foraging and a Moderate Wisdom (Survival) check, and feeds an extra 2d4 people
  • More country: you learn a second kind of country at 5th level, a third at 9th and a fourth at 13th, and may swap one by spending a Downtime Phase living in the new country.

Wild Shape

  • Effect: As your action, shapeshift into any beast or beast-like monster of Level no greater than two-thirds of your Druid level, rounded down (minimum Level 1), once per day (more often as you rise in level, below), choosing the form fresh each time (any beast in Monsters & Treasure, or one of these beast-like monsters: Owlbear, Death Dog, Hippogriff, Griffon, Ankheg, Bulette, Grick, Grick Alpha, Hook Horror, Young Remorhaz, Piercer and Rust Monster; others at the GM's call, but never a swarm, a spellcaster or a creature marked Solo; see Druid Forms).
  • Until 5th level a form with a flying speed must be Small or smaller.
  • Lasts up to 1 hour or until you revert, which takes no action.
  • You take the form's stat block from Monsters & Treasure: its HP, AC, attacks, Fortitude and Reflex saves and movement; the form's HP cannot exceed your own Max HP.
  • You keep your own mind and personality, your Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma, your Will save and your spell DC.
  • Your gear melds into the form and does nothing until you revert.
  • A spell you are concentrating on continues.
  • You cannot cast spells in Wild Shape until Wild Shape Casting lets you.
  • When the form drops to 0 HP you return to your own form with the HP you had when you changed (see Changing Shape in Spellcasting in Arneyan).
  • 3rd level: usable twice per day
  • 6th level: usable three times per day
  • 9th level: usable four times per day
  • 15th level: usable five times per day
  • 24th level: usable six times per day

2nd Level

Resist Elements

  • Effect: Advantage on saves against fire, cold, lightning and thunder damage, and against the abilities of elementals.

3rd Level

Woodland Stride

  • Effect: Move through natural difficult terrain, thorns, briars, overgrowth, at full speed with no damage or impairment, leaving no trail.
  • Magically manipulated terrain still impedes normally, your own spells included.

4th Level

Beast Kin

  • Effect: Natural beasts treat you one step friendlier on reaction rolls, and won't attack you first unless cornered, starving or magically compelled.
  • You can also make yourself understood to natural beasts, and understand them, through their own sounds and motions; expect simple impressions, not reports.
  • 9th level: the same with trees and growing things. Once per encounter, as your action, natural beasts and plant creatures within 60ft whose Level is no more than half yours make a Will save against your Class Save DC or leave, and do not return while you remain.

6th Level

Wild Shape Casting

  • Effect: While in Wild Shape you can cast your cantrips and your prepared spells of 1st and 2nd level; the beast's voice and movements serve for their components.
  • 10th level: spells of up to 4th level.
  • Your Wisdom modifier applies normally to all spells cast in this way.

7th Level

Primal Strikes

  • Effect: Your natural attacks in Wild Shape count as magical.

8th Level

Elemental Mastery

  • Effect: Choose fire, cold, lightning or thunder. You have Resistance to its damage.
  • 20th level: you are immune to that damage. Once per encounter, when a spell of that type would have damaged you, you may turn it on one creature within 60ft, which saves against the caster's DC as the spell says.

12th Level

Deepened Shape

  • Effect: While in Wild Shape you may change from one form to another as your action without spending another use. The new form starts with the HP the old form had left, never more than its own maximum.

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).

20th Level

Renown: Sacred Grove

  • Effect: You may found a sacred grove (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d4 initiates and the grove's beasts gather to it. While you hold it, you have one extra Wild Shape a day within a day's travel of the grove.

24th Level

Hierophant

  • Effect: You no longer age and are immune to poison and disease.
  • You may Wild Shape into a form of Level 4 or lower at will; your daily uses are for greater forms.
  • This is your own power.
  • The title is a seat in the Natural Order, which a druid may be offered in play when one falls vacant or a new circle is recognised.

Kits: Druidic Circles

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Druid folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • Druid Kits represent which circle a Druid was trained in.
  • The Cabal (the Natural Order) is an overarching druidic organisation with multiple regional circles, each led by a Hierophant.
  • Its Hierophants and Archdruids swear the balance (a True Neutral Allegiance); ordinary druids stay Unaligned.
  • Mournas has its own independent circle separate from the Cabal's structure.
  • The peoples, orders and places a kit names are examples, not the only ones: a kit suits anyone from a tradition like it.
